Row.Text: 4,400 annual Antiquity turns, 5,400 seasonal Exploration turns, and 2,400 monthly Modern turns, ending December 1949. Research, civics and celebrations follow the extended ages. Other speed-adjusted costs use Marathon pacing.
Calendar advances twice as fast as Realistic. Research, civics and celebrations use half the Realistic costs/durations; ages take half as many turns. Other speed-adjusted costs use Marathon pacing.

Calendar advances 3 times as fast as Realistic. Research, civics and celebrations use 1/3 the Realistic costs/durations; ages take 1/3 as many turns, rounded up. Other speed-adjusted costs use Marathon pacing.
Calendar advances 4 times as fast as Realistic. Research, civics and celebrations use 1/4 the Realistic costs/durations; ages take 1/4 as many turns. Other speed-adjusted costs use Marathon pacing.
Calendar advances 5 times as fast as Realistic. Research, civics and celebrations use 1/5 the Realistic costs/durations; ages take 1/5 as many turns. Other speed-adjusted costs use Marathon pacing.

Calendar advances 6 times as fast as Realistic. Research, civics and celebrations use 1/6 the Realistic costs/durations; ages take 1/6 as many turns, rounded up. Other speed-adjusted costs use Marathon pacing.
